verdict.rationale: Customer.io documents recurring tasks that its AI agent runs automatically on a schedule, such as deliverability reports, segment audits and broadcast recaps (docs-33). Its pricing page lists "Daily Routines (scheduled tasks)" (docs-57). The MCP server lets an AI client create and manage automations (docs-27), broadcasts can be queued for a specified time (docs-13), and reverse-ETL syncs can run as often as every minute (docs-56). missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule cadence and configuration options, evidence of recurring scheduled messaging workflows (not just agent report tasks) creatable via CLI or MCP, independent hands-on corroboration.
